questions.q: What page do you land on immediately after connecting Tableau to an Excel workbook, before any worksheet exists?
options: The Data Source page, showing the Sheets list and a preview grid
A blank worksheet with an empty canvas
The Show Me panel
The Extract History dialog
questions.explain: Every new connection opens on the Data Source page first, where you confirm sheets/tables and structure before building any chart.

questions.q: Why might a CSV file need extra configuration that an Excel file typically doesn't?
options: A delimited text file has no built-in info about column names, data types, or delimiter character, unlike an Excel workbook
CSV files cannot be connected to Tableau at all
CSV files always require a live database connection
Excel files never contain column headers
questions.explain: Text files are plain data with no inherent schema — Tableau has to guess the delimiter, header row, and text qualifier, and sometimes needs to be corrected via Text File Properties.

questions.q: In the CSV example screenshot, what does it mean that the columns are labeled F1, F2, F3...?
options: Tableau did not detect (or the file did not have) a header row with real column names
F1-F5 are special Tableau system fields present in every dataset
The file failed to connect properly
F1-F5 indicates the file is corrupted
questions.explain: Generic F1, F2, F3-style headers appear when Tableau doesn't have real column names to use, which you can fix via the table dropdown if the first row does contain headers.

questions.q: What does the 'Sheets' list show when connected to an Excel workbook?
options: The individual sheets (and named ranges) inside the workbook that can become tables in Tableau
A list of every calculated field you've created
A history of every extract refresh
The Live/Extract connection setting
questions.explain: An Excel workbook can contain multiple sheets or named ranges, and the Sheets list lets you pick which one(s) to use as a Tableau data table.

questions.q: What toggle appears on the Data Source page for both Excel and CSV connections, previewed in this lesson and covered fully later?
options: Live / Extract
Discrete / Continuous
Dimension / Measure
Wide / Long
questions.explain: Every Data Source page shows a Live/Extract connection toggle, which Lesson 9 covers in full detail.
